title: Initial Setup Run
statement: Let $K_0$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal O$ assign a Boolean to each of four query indices and each finite bit string, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a memory function. Suppose that for every $k\le |x|$, the first oracle answers true on the encoding of $x$ paired with the binary representation of $k$ exactly when $k<|x|$, and suppose $|x|+2\le B$. Then the machine has a finite run from the initial scan configuration with memory $M$ and head position $0$ to the first radius-copy phase, with every configuration satisfying the register and memory-head bounds in $G(x,B,P)$. At the endpoint the memory and head position are still $M$ and $0$, respectively, and all registers are zero except the logarithm-bound register, which equals $1+h(|x|)$, where $h(n)=0$ for $n=0$ and $h(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ for $n>0$.
hypotheses_covered: an oracle family on four query indices and bit strings
for every $k\le |x|$, the first oracle query on the encoded pair returns true exactly when $k<|x|$
replaced:
Let $K_0,B,P\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $\mathcal O$ be a family
of four Boolean oracles on bit strings, and let $M:\mathbb
Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a memory tape. Suppose that for every $k\le
|x|$, the first oracle answers true on the encoding of $x$ paired with the binary
representation of $k$ exactly when $k<|x|$. If $|x|+2\le B$, then the machine $A(K_0)$
has a finite run from the initial scan configuration, with all intermediate
configurations satisfying the register and head-position bounds in $G(x,B,P)$, that
reaches the configuration at the first radius-copy phase with every register zero except
that the logarithm register equals $1+\mathrm{hv}(|x|)$; the memory tape remains $M$ and
its head remains at $0$.
